question: Who among the following was one of the two recipients of Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajrang Punia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bajrang Punia** is an accomplished Indian freestyle wrestler.
 
• He has won multiple medals at various international competitions including the World Wrestling Championships, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• Bajrang Punia received the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** in 2019, which is India's highest sporting honor.
 
• He is known for his dedication and hard work, making significant contributions to Indian wrestling on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

 
 
• It is the highest sporting honor of the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The award is named after Rajiv Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• It was instituted in 1991-1992 and the first recipient was Chess Grandmaster Vishwanathan Anand.
 
• The award includes a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Fouaad Mirza**
 
 
• Fouaad Mirza is an Indian equestrian who also received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2019.
 
• He is known for his achievements in the discipline of eventing.
 
• He won a silver medal at the 2018 Asian Games.
 
 
 
• **Poonam Yadav**
 
 
• Poonam Yadav is an Indian cricketer who plays for the Indian women's cricket team.
 
• She is a leg-spin bowler and has been a crucial player in various international tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Chinglensana Singh Kangujam**
 
 
• Chinglensana Singh Kangujam is an Indian field hockey player.
 
• He has represented India in various international hockey tournaments and has been a key player in the team.
